_comment: b1 #199 'The Chieftain's Price' meeting graph. NARRATIVE PURPOSE: first contact with Rags — the conduct-gated reward for goblin mercy; opens the quest and carries all three resolution paths (SUPPLY item / BROKER gold / FIGHT betrayal). TONE: wary, quiet, transactional warmth at the edges. LORE: early-volume Rags (profile: 1-4 word utterances, no articles; chess is the Erin link). Voice contract: docs/design/character-profiles.md#rags. Costs follow the witch pattern: SUPPLY consumes a 10g draught, BROKER charges 6g, FIGHT is the betrayal close (start_combat on end). Back-out exit stays free and ungated (softlock guard).

hub.speaker: Rags
hub.text: You. The one who didn't kill.

ask.speaker: Rags
ask._comment: The problem beat: wounded tribe, Watch sweep. She trades, never begs — offers the carved piece FIRST.
ask.text: Watch came. Goblins hurt. Not begging.

price.speaker: Rags
price._comment: She holds up a carved chess pawn — her own work. The chess link is the one shared language (profile).

options.text: Krshia's stall could spare supplies. I'll stand the cost. (6 gold)

sealed.speaker: Rags
sealed._comment: Close beat. The Erin chess nod — smallest possible thaw, no fluency.
sealed.text: Good trade. Inn Human plays chess. Tell her: Rags wins next one.
